_meta.description: Compose batch of two crosstab slots over region x segment on experiment.pulse, population (every row) and audience (the variant arm), decorated with an OVERLAY_FORMULA cell overlay whose expression reads both slots by label: slot.audience.cell / slot.population.cell, the audience's share of each cell (0.40 to 0.69 here). OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_REF (12_compose_audience_index_vs_total.json) gives the same ratio x 100; a formula earns its keep when one expression mixes several slots, e.g. (slot.us.cell - slot.uk.cell) / slot.world.cell. The expression compiles once and runs per cell; a number or bool result is kept (bool as 0 / 1), anything else is PULSE_OVERLAY_FORMULA_TYPE_MISMATCH. Predict refuses an unknown identifier with PULSE_OVERLAY_FORMULA_INVALID_IDENT, slot.<label> on a single request included (reason: slot namespace is Compose-only). Buffered.
_meta.name: compose-overlay-formula
